name: Proxy-GS Cluster Rasterizer
definition: A GPU-accelerated rasterization pipeline for clustered 3D primitives using Vulkan mesh shaders and compute shaders for traversal and culling.
summary: The Proxy-GS Cluster Rasterizer is a GPU-accelerated Vulkan pipeline for Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses compute-shader-driven traversal and culling to efficiently handle clustered primitives and Level of Detail structures.
